messages.content: Extract grounded concepts and implicit bridging relations from CURRENT_RESPONSE, using earlier dialogue/graph only as context. Return JSON {"nodes":[{"name":"short concept","span":"exact substring of current response","dimensions":["social_role"]}],"edges":[{"source":"concept name","target":"concept name","relation":"part-of","span":"exact substring of current response"}],"competitions":[]}. Dimensions may be social_role, personality, background, interests. Relations may be part-of, member-of, instrument, theme, cause-of, in, temporal. Include only concepts and edges supported by current-response spans. Reuse canonical names; do not substitute synonyms merely because they seem related. A competition, if retained, has alternatives (at least two distinct readings), spans (at least two distinct retained node-support spans), and discriminator (a concrete unanswered question distinguishing them). Omit unsupported competition. Return only JSON. Also inspect previous_graph and earlier_dialogue for competing interpretations. Return competitions only when two distinct retained support spans ground two different readings and provide a concrete unanswered discriminator. Newly extracted nodes/edges must still cite the current response; deterministic host code computes coverage and novelty.
